svg.text: SI CONSOLE
02 WIRING DIAGRAM
REV R1 | DATE 2026-11-20
DRAFT, NOT FOR SUBMISSION
Physical layout, wire colours, labels, lengths. Breakout to each part.
WIRING LAYOUT, TOP VIEW, INSIDE CASE 360 x 240 mm, LOOKING DOWN
CASE OUTLINE 360 W x 240 D mm, 3 mm ACRYLIC, ASSUMED SIZE, SEE 04
PI 5 8GB, REAR LEFT
85 x 56 mm VERIFIED. USB / ETH to rear wall.
GPIO header top edge. M2.5 standoffs 10 mm.
Active cooler on top. Leave 25 mm clear above.
BREAKOUT / PERFBOARD, CENTRE
Pi-EzConnect HAT or ribbon breakout ASSUMED.
ULN2003 DIP-16 here. 5V rail, GND rail.
6 resistors in a row. See 01 for values.
Check HAT clearance vs Active Cooler first.
USB SPEAKER, FRONT RIGHT
USB only. Keep 20 mm gap from Pi.
Grille holes in front panel ASSUMED.
FRONT PANEL, INSIDE VIEW, 360 x 140 mm
G GREEN 30 mm | R RED 30 mm | K KILL 22 mm | PTT 12 mm | LANG 12 mm | LEDs 5 mm x4
Buttons face forward. Wires run from breakout to front panel.
TOP PANEL: MINI SCREEN 121 x 89.48 mm, bezel cutout 122 x 90.5 mm ASSUMED. HDMI + USB power, not GPIO.
MAIN MONITOR outside case, behind, on own stand. Micro HDMI to Pi HDMI0. Mini screen to Pi HDMI1.
WIRE TABLE, COLOUR, LABEL, LENGTH, ROUTE
LABEL COLOUR FROM - TO LENGTH NOTE
G Green GPIO17 P11 to green switch 25 cm ASSUMED Twist with GND, Dupont / 22 AWG
R Red GPIO27 P13 to red switch 25 cm ASSUMED Twist with GND
K Yellow GPIO22 P15 to kill NC 30 cm ASSUMED Twist with GND, keep clear of Pi
PTT White GPIO23 P16 to PTT switch 30 cm ASSUMED Twist with GND
LANG Orange GPIO24 P18 to toggle 30 cm ASSUMED Twist with GND
COORD Green GPIO5 P29 to ULN IN1 15 cm ASSUMED On perfboard / short Dupont
AGENT 1 Red GPIO6 P31 to ULN IN2 15 cm ASSUMED On perfboard
AGENT 2 Blue GPIO13 P33 to ULN IN3 15 cm ASSUMED On perfboard
GUARD Yellow GPIO19 P35 to ULN IN4 15 cm ASSUMED On perfboard
GRN LED Green GPIO20 P38 to ULN IN5 15 cm ASSUMED On perfboard
RED LED Red GPIO21 P40 to ULN IN6 15 cm ASSUMED On perfboard
SPARE Grey GPIO26 P37 to ULN IN7 15 cm ASSUMED Tie IN7 to GND if unused
5V Red Pi 5V P2/P4 to LED rail 15 cm ASSUMED Do not power LEDs from GPIO
GND Black Pi GND P6/P30 to GND rail 15-30 cm ASSUMED Common GND bus on perfboard
USB MIC Black USB Pi USB-A to FIFINE AM8 1.0 m cable Outside case, desk left
USB SPKR Black USB Pi USB-A to speaker 0.5 m ASSUMED Inside case, front right
HDMI MAIN Black Pi micro HDMI0 to MSI monitor 1.0 m ASSUMED Through rear cable cutout
HDMI MINI Black Pi micro HDMI1 to mini screen 0.5 m ASSUMED Short, inside / top
Rule: button wires under 30 cm, LED wires under 20 cm, twist GPIO and GND together per button.
Label every wire at both ends: G, R, K, PTT, LANG, COORD, AGENT 1, AGENT 2, GUARD, GND.
Spade connectors: female 4.8 mm for switch contacts. 6.3 mm only if a button LED is wired later.
ASSUMPTIONS
* All wire lengths ASSUMED estimates, not measured. Measure on the real case and cut to fit, keep under the max in the table.
* Case size 360 x 240 x 140 mm ASSUMED proposal from W3. Confirm in CAD before cutting.
* Breakout choice ASSUMED: Pi-EzConnect HAT, fallback ribbon breakout. HAT clearance vs cooler is untested.
* Speaker grille size and position ASSUMED. Measure the real speaker first.
* GND pin sharing in the table is ASSUMED. Any Pi GND pin works. Use pins 6, 9, 14, 20, 25, 30, 34, 39.
